description: This is a two-tiered white wire dish rack. The top tier is designed to hold plates, with numerous vertical slots to keep them upright and separated. Below this, the second tier is a flat grid surface, suitable for holding bowls, cups, or other kitchenware. The rack is supported by two curved uprights on each side, giving it a simple yet functional design. The entire structure appears to be made of white-coated metal wire, suggesting durability and ease of cleaning. It is a practical item for organizing and drying dishes in a kitchen.
